Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-15475 UI Editor: On rename of any page element, select the existing text(so that user can start typing new value directly) Tools:UI Editor No UI Editor: When renaming a page element, the existing text is selected, enabling the user to start typing the new value right away. After the rename dialog box is opened the text inside the input box is automatically selected. PROC-9723 Message Monitor - Endpoint information on popover Tools: Message monitor No On hovering over the endpoint, the details will be displayed in a popover. End point Details like Registration date, last active date ,Last transaction, device type and status will be shown. The popover functionality has been added to show the endpoint details when hovered over. PROC-15240 BOL Editor -Add validation to restrict changing the primary keys in the child flavor Tools: Bol Editor No The primary key cannot be modified in entities passed from the parent app to the child app, nor in entities created using an older flavor version. These restrictions are in place to maintain data integrity and consistency across different versions and flavors. PROC-16164 Validation while adding and saving in App Hierarchy Detail Section Tools -System Admin No App Hierarchy Detail Section added Validation. A validation is now in place to prevent creating cyclic JSON structures when assigning a parent to a flavor, ensuring no crashes occur. Additionally, if a flavor version is deleted and a new version of the same flavor is assigned immediately, it won't work. The user must save changes before adding the new version. Details: App Hierarchy

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-15842 IFB- File size restriction on attachment upload Ui Controls- kloAttach Control No Added 2 new properties in UI editor for kloAttach control : Introduced a new property to restrict user attachments based on requirements, enhancing control. Two new properties, `maxFileSizeAttachment` and `showFileSizeRestriction`, along with their validations, have been added for all four modes in the KloAttach control. Additionally, a text display shows users the file size limit and supported file types (if enabled). Details: KloControls User guide

Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption doc Short Description PROC-16358 Appropriate Message to be shown if no internet connectivity KloTouch-klobo No Introduced a new banner notification that will appear when an online request fails due to network issues, informing the user of a "No Internet Connection." The banner will automatically disappear when the user navigates to a different screen. However, if the user tries to access an online screen without an internet connection, the banner will reappear. Once the internet connection is restored, the banner will be removed automatically. PROC-10397 For the screens in which Pivot modeler is used, properties used in modeler is missing in List screen KloTouch When an entity property is placed inside the report modeler's column (as a child of the report), if a control with the same name as the entity property already exists in that section then the control will be added with a different id to the report modeler. PROC-15102 Excel Download: Numeric(Decimal) Data Exported as String KloTouch Excel Download: Numeric (Decimal) Data Exported as String, so when downloading an Excel file, if any entity property has a numeric data type (such as Decimal (1), Decimal (2), Decimal (3), Integer 8, Integer 16, Integer 32), the corresponding column in the Excel file will be formatted as a number. In the `prepareXLSXFromJSON` method of `kloSectionXlsx`, if any entity property has a numeric data type (Decimal (1), Decimal (2), Decimal (3)), the respective column in the generated Excel file will be formatted as a number. PROC-10397 For the screens in which Pivot modeler is used, properties used in modeler is missing in List screen KloTouch If an entity property is added to the report modeler's column as a child of the report, and a control with the same name already exists in that section, the control will be added to the report modeler with a unique ID.

documents.t: Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-18584 UI Editor: Device need to be added in "Preview In" and existing needs correction No Tools - UI Editor Enhanced preview functionality by adding new device options to "Preview In" feature and corrected existing device preview settings for better responsive design testing. Status: **Tested** PROC-20605 UI Editor: Coping a existing page to a different App, changes the id of the controls copied to previous id+"_copy01" No Tools - UI Editor Fixed issue where copying pages between apps resulted in incorrect control ID naming convention. Controls now maintain proper unique IDs when copied across applications. Status: **Tested** PROC-20474 Wizard: Update through wizard is not working for child entity No Tools - UI Editor Resolved wizard update functionality for child entities. Updates to child entities through wizard interface now work correctly. Status: **Tested** PROC-19513 Primary key update should be restricted (UI editor) No Tools - UI Editor Implemented restrictions on primary key updates in UI editor to prevent data integrity issues and maintain referential consistency. Status: **Tested** PROC-21284 Please update the package.json "libphonenumber-js": "^1.12.9" to the vsix No BOL - Private Node (VS Code) Updated libphonenumber-js package to version 1.12.9 in VSIX package for improved phone number validation and formatting capabilities. Status: **Tested** PROC-19721 Feature Request – Read-Only Code Checkout for a User No BOL - Private Node (VS Code) Developers can access and analyze the application's code and structure to debug or investigate issues. However, code modifications are restricted unless the app is explicitly assigned to them. Only developers have permission to save files within the app. While referencing logic is allowed during custom development, existing workflows can be explored safely without the risk of unintended changes. Status: **Tested**

Status: Tested PROC-24489 Restrict App build in case of any validation errors No Tools - UI Editor The application build process is now blocked when validation errors are present in screen configuration. Users attempting to build with unresolved validation errors will be prevented from proceeding, ensuring only valid configurations are deployed. Status: Tested PROC-23355 Notification Editor: Attachments and emojis are not coming in mails No Tools - Other (Notification Editor) Resolved an issue where emojis configured in notification email templates were not being rendered or included in outgoing emails. emoji characters now appear correctly in delivered emails. Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-25597 Node Cache Master Bottleneck No BOL / Server - Server The same node was acting as both a processing node and cache master, creating a bottleneck and causing significant delays. Implemented a dedicated Cache Master isolation so the cache master process runs separately from application processing nodes, improving throughput and response times. Status: Tested PROC-25082 API Validation: System Endpoints should not get DEBOARDED from ADM APIs No BOL Added API-level validation to prevent system-level endpoints (TENANT, SAP_LOCAL, SAP_ONLINE) from being deboarded via ADM APIs. Previously, these critical system endpoints could be inadvertently removed, causing platform instability. Status: Tested PROC-24945 Middleware: Implement retry logic for failed messages in case of deadlock No BOL - Middleware Enhanced middleware resilience: Messages now automatically retry up to 3 times with 2 seconds of delay by default when encountering database deadlock or lock timeout errors. The retry settings can be configured via config.json: "MiddlewareRetrySettings": { "DeadlockRetryCount": 3, "RetryDelaySeconds": 2 } Document Link: Message Monitoring 7.0 User Guide - Point No. 5. Status: Tested PROC-24594 BOL Node 512 MB: Node Master Isolation (Cache/Middleware/Scheduler) No BOL Isolated the BOL Node Master from serving application data. The Master node is now dedicated exclusively to orchestration tasks (Cache/Middleware/Scheduler), freeing application nodes to serve user requests without contention from master-level operations. Status: Done - Closed PROC-24581 Add Validation or Info Message on change of Query Type to Aggregate No BOL Editor Added a validation/informational message when a developer changes a query type to Aggregate in the BOL Editor. Previously, switching query types could cause wizard failures due to column mismatches in transient return entities. The message now alerts developers to review their screen configuration before proceeding. Status: Tested User Guide: BOL Editor - User Guide 7.0 PROC-24422 Updated child relations data not getting fetched when main list is refreshed No BOL / KloTouch Fixed an issue where updated child entity data was not being fetched when the parent list was refreshed using the default refresh button on the section toolbar. Child relation data is now correctly reloaded on list refresh. Status: Tested PROC-24281 Private Node: A popup should be shown when tokens are expired No BOL - Private Node (VS Code) A popup notification is now displayed to the developer when the session expires in the Private Node. Previously, session expiry caused silent failures. Users are now prompted to create a new private node session. Status: Tested PROC-22651 Entity Relation Improvements No BOL Fixed a behavior in aggregate relationships between entities where, if the relation mapping property in Table A was null, the system would fetch all records from Table B by default. This unrestricted fetch is now blocked, aligning with the expected relationship behavior. Status: Tested PROC-22647 PROD: Transport Screen is not loading because adm flavor is assigned as a tester in the source landscape No Tools - Other (Transport) Fixed transport screen loading issue where querying source system apps failed due to ADM flavor not assigned to transport users. The transport screen now loads correctly regardless of the adm flavor assignment to the transport user. Status: Tested

Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-25478 Wizard screen creation should generate tags to detail screens by default No KloTouch When creating screens via the Wizard, tags to linked detail screens are now generated automatically by default. This eliminates the need for developers to manually add tags after wizard screen creation, improving productivity in wizard-based navigation flows. Status: Tested UI Editor - Wizard Page Creation PROC-25476 Deep Link should handle Tags No KloTouch Deep link navigation has been enhanced to support tag-based routing, similar to how NavTo handles tags. Deep links can now resolve and navigate to screens using tags, enabling more flexible and consistent mobile navigation experiences. Status: Tested Tags Documentation PROC-25479 SEAM4: A new key is required in ResourceUtilization to pass utilization No mTouch (Gantt Controls) Added a new key in oTreeGanttWrapper.setResourceUtilization({}) to support passing resource utilization directly, instead of calculating it only from start and end dates. Additionally, a custom color property for Gantt visualization is now supported. Status: Ready for QA

This caused push notifications to reach devices with the message "Notification not meant for you". Endpoints are now correctly cleaned up on user removal. Status: Tested

Module: BOL Editor / Dev Tools Below are the new features, improvements, and bug fixes delivered in this release for BOL Editor and Dev Tools. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-25909 BOL Editor: Auto Number Behaviour Is Not Consistent Fixed an inconsistency in the Auto Number field where generated numbers occasionally started from 1001 instead of the expected sequence. The auto-number generator now produces a reliable, consistent sequence. N/A PROC-25839 Show Warning / Error If Two Properties Use the Same Label in the Same Entity BOL Editor now raises a warning when two properties within the same entity share an identical label, preventing ambiguity at runtime and improving data quality during schema design. User Guide: Data Studio- User Guide 7.0 N/A PROC-26051 Entity Creation via Excel Sheet: Support for Config VH Creation (s_status etc.) The Excel-based entity creation utility now supports creation of config-type value helps (e.g. s_status) in addition to regular entities, significantly reducing manual setup steps for new entities. User Guide: Data Studio- User Guide 7.0 N/A PROC-23549 Training: Incorrect Automatic Import When Typecasting Using Private Node Suggestion Fixed the code editor's auto-import logic when accepting a typecast suggestion from Private Node. The incorrect import statement is no longer inserted; the correct module path is used. N/A 3. Module: UI Editor / Wizard Below are the improvements and bug fixes delivered in this release for UI Editor and Notification Modeler. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-24424 UI Editor Wizard: Integer/Decimal Column Headers and Cell Content Should Be Right-Aligned in Grid and Tree In the UI Editor Wizard, columns configured with Integer or Decimal property types now correctly right-align both header text and cell content in Grid and Tree screen types, matching standard numerical display conventions. Reference document : Page Builder- User Guide 7.0 N/A PROC-26821 Add Validation to Restrict Template ID Length to 25 Characters in Notification Modeler The Notification Modeler now enforces a maximum length of 25 characters for Template IDs at validation time, preventing downstream processing errors caused by oversized template identifiers. N/A 4. Module: kloReact / React Runtime Below are the bug fixes and improvements delivered in this release for the kloReact / React runtime, covering both web and mobile UI issues. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-26727 kloReact APK/IPA: Notification Red Dot Not Removed After Marking All Notifications as Read Fixed a defect in kloReact APK and IPA builds where the notification red dot badge persisted even after all notifications were marked as read, causing confusion for mobile users. N/A PROC-26726 kloReact BOL Editor: Change Icon on VH Screen Does Not Open Icon Dialog Resolved a bug where clicking the 'Change' icon button on the VH (Value Help) screen in the BOL Editor under a kloReact environment did not open the icon picker dialog. N/A PROC-26725 kloReact: UI-Type VH Is Not Editable in Specific Scenario Fixed a scenario in kloReact where a Value Help of UI type was rendered as read-only when it should have been editable, preventing users from updating the VH value. N/A PROC-26719 kloReact: Upgrade Banner Click Throws Error as Alert Resolved an issue where clicking the upgrade banner in kloReact displayed a JavaScript error as a browser alert popup instead of handling it gracefully. N/A PROC-26718 kloReact: Menu Became Blank on Desktop During Parallel Mobile Testing with Same User Fixed a race condition in kloReact where the desktop menu became blank when the same user account was simultaneously active in a mobile session, caused by conflicting menu state updates. N/A PROC-26716 kloReact: Create Button Alignment and Checkbox Size Mismatch in User Collections Corrected a CSS mismatch between kloTouch and kloReact runtime in the User Collections screen — the Create button alignment and individual check/tick-box size are now consistent. N/A PROC-26714 kloReact: User Details Not Showing After Navigating to About Page Then Logging Out Fixed an issue where navigating to the About page and then logging out caused user details to be absent on the next login, due to stale session state not being cleared. N/A PROC-26713 kloReact: Incorrect Alignment on Login Page Corrected layout alignment issues on the kloReact login page, ensuring consistent positioning across screen sizes and device types. N/A PROC-26158 React Phase 01: SAP Icons Should Not Be Shown for React Flavors in Any Tool SAP-specific icon sets are no longer displayed in Dev Tools for React-type flavors, as SAP icons are not applicable to React runtime environments. N/A PROC-25987 React Phase 01: Delay Should Not Be Used for Loading kloTouch Files Removed artificial delays used when loading kloTouch files in the React runtime. Files are now loaded via a proper event-driven mechanism, improving startup performance and reliability. N/A PROC-21063 No Internet Connection Banner: UI Improvement Improved icons, responsiveness and alignment of No Internet Connection and Upgrade banners for better display across mobile and desktop resolutions. N/A PROC-23390 navByQuery Not Working in Mobile Application When Navigating with kloGuid Control Fixed a bug preventing navByQuery from functioning correctly on mobile applications when navigation was triggered via a kloGuid control, restoring expected deep-navigation behaviour. N/A 5. Module: BOL Node / Server / Middleware Below are the improvements and bug fixes delivered in this release for BOL Node 512 MB, server-side message processing, and middleware. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-24595 BOL Node 512 MB: Middleware Message Dispatch Messages are now correctly excluded from dispatch to dedicated nodes and master node for processing when running in the 512 MB BOL Node configuration, preventing unnecessary processing overhead. N/A PROC-24592 BOL Node 512 MB: Server-Side Query Streaming (Rules / Scheduler / AppService) Implemented server-side query streaming for Rules, Scheduler, and AppService executions in the 512 MB BOL Node environment, enabling efficient processing of large result sets without memory overflow. N/A PROC-25937 Message Monitoring: Queries Need to Be Optimised Optimised the server queue monitor queries that were causing slowdowns due to 3.1 million records in the ma_tenant_log_q table. Indexes and query refactoring significantly reduce monitor execution time. N/A PROC-26584 More Than One Master Found: Service cacheMaster Fixed a parallel election race condition in middleware where multiple nodes started simultaneously and each declared itself master. The election protocol now correctly ensures a single master is elected. N/A 6. Module: Mobile (APK / IPA) Below are the bug fixes delivered in this release for the mobile APK and IPA builds. Note: an APK/IPA rebuild is required for PROC-24144. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-24144 Unnecessary Permission Requests in APK for KloRemark and Document Upload Removed spurious permission prompts in the Android APK: KloRemark no longer requests microphone permission on screen load without user interaction, and Document Upload no longer triggers unnecessary storage permissions. Both now request permissions only at the point of use. APK/IPA rebuild required 7. Module: Account Console / Permissions / Notifications Below are the improvements delivered in this release for Account Console role management and push notifications. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-26524 Enhancement: Enforce Default Permissions and Validation for New Roles At DEV Systems, after a new role creation, a warning box will be shown on the screen, to inform the developers about maintaining the permissions for that new role, to avoid Access Denied scenario for the respective users belonging to that role. Document: LINK . N/A PROC-25592 Push Notification: Improvements When a notification is clicked by a different user, the app shows a Switch User message with notification user details and switch information about switching accounts and possible unsaved data loss. If there are unsaved changes, an additional warning note is also displayed. Also, once the intended user logs back in, missed notifications can be reviewed anytime from the Notification Centre (🔔). Document: LINK . N/A 8. Module: Server-Side Pivot / Report / Chart Below are the new features delivered in this release for PIVOT, REPORT, and CHART screen types. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-25423 Phase 01 Runtime: Server-Side Pivoting for PIVOT / REPORT / CHART Screens Pivoting operations for PIVOT, REPORT, and CHART screen types are now executed server-side rather than on the client, significantly improving performance for large datasets and reducing browser memory usage. N/A 9. Module: Business AI Below are the new features delivered in this release for the Business AI module. Issue No. Description Adoption / Script PROC-26816 Business AI: Application Workflow Context Implementation — POC and Phase 1 Completed POC and Phase 1 implementation of application workflow context for Business AI. The AI assistant can now understand and reason about the workflow state of the current application, enabling context-aware suggestions. N/A PROC-26745 Business AI: VH Query Suggestion Display to User Business AI now surfaces Value Help query suggestions to the user during data entry. When a VH Query field requires idata, the AI fires a query matching on key or description and presents the best matches for user selection. N/A 10. Below are the list of new features/bug fixes developed as a part of the release in this module. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-27362 OData BO Support – Deep Update (Header + Child updates in a single call) No BOL Extended OData support to allow deep update operations where both header and child entity data can be updated in a single API call. Previously, multi-level updates required sequential requests, increasing round trips. Clients can send nested JSON payloads containing parent entity properties along with child entity arrays. Child entities are automatically matched by parent key - existing children are updated, and new children are created.All operations are committed in a single transaction with full validation support. This significantly reduces overhead for complex entity hierarchies. Document Link Status: Tested PROC-27343 BOL Node 512 MB Stability Verification & Issue Resolution No BOL Verified stability of the BOL Node running under a 512 MB memory constraint and resolved all identified issues. Ensures the platform operates reliably within constrained memory environments for applicable deployments. Status: Done - Closed PROC-27366 Middleware: 1000 messages with no_sequence=0 took 17 minutes to process No BOL - Middleware Resolved a middleware throughput issue where 1000 messages with no_sequence=0 took 17 minutes to complete against only 1 minute of actual processing time (16 minutes idle). Queuing and dispatch logic has been optimized to eliminate idle wait between message batches. Status: Tested PROC-26465 Middleware: Default retry delay for deadlock/lock wait should be increased No BOL - Middleware For the middleware retry settings for Inbound Messages, the RetryDelaySeconds default value has been changed to 1 second in the config.json file. If it’s already overridden, then that value is not changed. Document Link Status: Tested PROC-25080 Transport log showing source and target landscape as "undefined" No BOL - Transport Fixed a transport logging defect where source and target landscape names appeared as "undefined" in the transport log. Landscape identifiers are now correctly resolved and displayed in all transport log entries. Status: Tested PROC-26541 Indexing required on Users Permissions table – madm_user_permissions No BOL Added a composite index on the r_user_id & r_landscape column in the madm_user_permissions table to improve query performance for user-based permission lookups. Status: Tested PROC-26503 Remove deprecated entity reference button or handle logic in BOL / BOL Editor No BOL / BOL Editor Removed the deprecated entity reference-based condition button from the BOL Editor UI. Updated the underlying logic to prevent duplicate condition generation and to ignore deprecated backward-compatibility paths, eliminating developer confusion caused by legacy UI artifacts. Status: Tested PROC-26994 Custom template should be enabled for OTP Services No BOL OTP notification services can now use custom message templates. Previously OTP messages were fixed to a system template. Developers can now configure custom templates for OTP emails and SMS channels, enabling branded OTP communications per application. Status: Tested Reference Document : Notification Developer Guide PROC-26106 Attachment: setAttachmentP() not working on server side No BOL Fixed a bug where setAttachmentP() called from server-side logic (entity callbacks or controllers) threw a "File Write Failed" error. The server-side attachment API now correctly processes and persists file data. Status: Tested PROC-25752 Phase 02 Runtime – PIVOT/REPORT/CHART: Server-side pivoting No BOL Implemented Phase 2 of server-side data pivoting. Pivot, Report, and Chart data transformations are now computed on the server instead of the client browser, reducing client-side load and significantly improving performance for large datasets. Status: Tested User Guide link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oNQqNsgTLLFqtPn7914ggasXzJTDXc-oSo6QBYq9T6Y/edit?tab=t.0 PROC-22355 API Versioning Behavior Creates Misleading User Experience No BOL Corrected API URL versioning behaviour that was ignoring explicitly requested patch versions and automatically redirecting to the latest patch. API version resolution now honours the requested version, giving developers predictable and accurate versioning. Status: Done - Closed PROC-25409 BOL Editor: Excel-uploaded entry not present after refreshing (Rollup status and Status Config) No BOL Editor Fixed a persistence bug in BOL Editor where entries added via Excel upload were not retained after a page refresh in the Rollup Status and Status Config views. Uploaded entries now correctly persist to the database and reload on refresh. Status: Tested PROC-24593 BOL Node 512 MB – OData GET Services No BOL Validated and ensured OData GET service functionality is fully operational in the BOL Node 512 MB memory configuration. Addressed compatibility issues specific to this constrained memory deployment scenario. Status: Tested PROC-25001 BOL/Metadata: adding vh to query parameter not updating query generation No BOL Fixed a metadata query generation bug where adding a value help (vh) to a query parameter did not correctly update the generated query. The query generator now correctly incorporates vh-based parameters, ensuring accurate data retrieval. Status: Tested PROC-24749 Training: get$Role() returning empty object {} in controller and console No BOL Resolved an issue where get$Role() returned {} instead of the user's role data when called from a controller. The function now correctly retrieves and returns the active user role, consistent with $SYSTEM.roleId behaviour. Status: Tested PROC-27146 Safeguards to prevent recursive invocation between entity callback and CommitP API No BOL Added runtime safeguards to detect and break recursive call loops that occur when an entity callback triggers a CommitP API call, which in turn re-invokes the entity callback. Prevents infinite recursion and stack overflow in server-side business logic. Validation added in case the same transaction is being used for commitP() from callbacks throwing error as “Transaction commit is already in progress. Please wait for the current commit to finish before calling commit again.“. e.g., Developers should not use commitP() by using the same transaction at the rules callbacks - get the transaction from oEvent (function parameter) and use that for commitP() later on in the rules callback. Document Link 1, Document Link 2 Status: Tested PROC-26611 SEAM4: error_code missing in kloerror when commitP fails No BOL Fixed a bug where the error_code field was absent in the kloerror response object when a commitP operation failed. The error_code is now correctly populated, enabling downstream error handling to distinguish and respond to specific failure types. Status: Tested

Previously this selection was only available via Developer AI. Also includes fixes for known issues in the wizard screen creation flow. Developers can now create wizard-type screens entirely from the UI Editor. Navigation flows on homepage-type screens now behave correctly per the defined test specification. Feature Adoption Tool & Short Description PROC-27164 Business AI – Application Context implementation Phase 2 No Business AI Completed Phase 2 of the Application Context feature for Business AI. This phase integrates kloQuery callbacks and additional AI context scenarios, enabling Business AI to generate queries and responses with richer, application-aware data. Status: Tested Reference Guide - Business_AI_User_Guide PROC-26607 Developer AI – User/App level token limits and usage metrics No Developer AI Implemented configurable token limit enforcement and usage tracking at user and application level for Developer AI. Administrators can now set per-user and per-app token quotas; usage metrics are tracked for governance and cost control. Status: Tested PROC-27240 Developer AI – All LLM calls properly logged in LangSmith No Developer AI All LLM calls from Developer AI are now captured in LangSmith with proper, searchable names. Previously generic entries made it impossible to isolate individual AI call chains. Each call now appears with a meaningful identifier. Status: Tested PROC-27215 Developer AI – Early return on dependency failure in agents No Developer AI Added early-exit logic across RuleAgent, SchedulerAgent, NotificationAgent, and SampleDataAgent. If any upstream dependency fails mid-execution, the agent immediately returns a clear error instead of continuing with partial or misleading output. Status: Tested PROC-26921 Developer AI – Code files fetched from actual repository No Developer AI Developer AI now fetches existing code files directly from the version-controlled source repository instead of the local file system, ensuring AI modifications are based on the live codebase rather than potentially stale copies. Status: Tested PROC-27598 Developer AI – Qdrant not supporting 3072 dimensions No Developer AI Fixed a vector storage compatibility issue where Qdrant rejected 3072-dimension embeddings. The Qdrant collection is now correctly configured to support the required dimensionality for the AI embedding model in use. Status: Tested PROC-27565 Developer AI – Incorrect accountId in payload causing metadata save error No Developer AI Corrected a payload bug where an incorrect accountId caused AI metadata save operations to fail. The payload now correctly resolves and includes the authenticated user's accountId before submission. Status: Tested PROC-27214 Developer AI – Run-only-jobs includes screen creation in response No Developer AI Fixed a response scoping issue where selecting "run only jobs" in Developer AI still returned screen creation results. The agent now correctly restricts execution and response to the selected job types only. Status: Tested PROC-27128 Developer AI – Errors in Google Cloud logs during normal operation No Developer AI Resolved error-level log entries in Google Cloud logs triggered by normal Developer AI operations. Log levels have been corrected and error handling improved to eliminate false-alarm log noise. Status: Tested PROC-27034 Developer AI – Handle transient fields in SampleDataAgent/RuleAgents/NotificationAgent No Developer AI Updated agents to correctly differentiate Regular, Transient, and Calculated property types. Previously transient fields were incorrectly included in insert operations, causing errors and invalid data generation. Status: Tested PROC-27024 Developer AI – getEntitiesDetails API returning all properties as Regular No Developer AI Fixed a logic bug where getEntitiesDetails returned all properties as "Regular" regardless of actual type. Property types are now correctly derived from entity configuration (Transient, Calculated, Regular). Status: Tested PROC-27021 Developer AI – Attachment and GeoLocation must be transient, not regular No Developer AI Corrected property type classification for Attachment and GeoLocation to Transient, as these are not persisted directly in the entity table. Ensures correct handling by all AI agents. Status: Tested PROC-26309 Developer AI – Clear message when requested App is not found No Developer AI Improved error handling so Developer AI returns a clear, actionable message when a requested application does not exist, instead of a generic failure. Status: Tested PROC-26281 Developer AI – Handle concurrent multi-user requests No Developer AI Implemented concurrency handling for simultaneous multi-user Developer AI requests. Each user's workflow now executes in full isolation, preventing session cross-contamination. Status: Tested PROC-26278 Developer AI – Use incremental IDs for screens, remove datekey No Developer AI Replaced timestamp-based datekeys in AI-generated screen IDs with deterministic incremental IDs. Added duplicate ID checks. Produces cleaner, predictable identifiers for AI-generated screens. Status: Tested PROC-26277 Developer AI – Multiple subscreen layouts incorrectly added to one subscreen No Developer AI Fixed a screen generation defect where multiple subscreen layout definitions were attached to the same subscreen. Each subscreen now receives only its designated layout. Status: Tested PROC-26271 Developer AI – Validate each metadata item created for screen No Developer AI Added per-metadata validation during AI screen generation. Each generated metadata item is individually validated before persistence, allowing errors to be caught granularly. Status: Tested PROC-25033 React Phase 01 – Playwright automation No React UI Implemented Playwright-based automated test coverage for React Phase 01 deliverables. Establishes a regression test baseline for the React UI track. Status: Tested
